packageRules.description: matrix-synapse floor bumps default to 'chore', which never triggers a Release Please release/rebuild. Force 'fix' here so every new Synapse release actually reaches the built image, not just the README badge.

MAS version bumps default to 'chore', which does not trigger a release/image rebuild in Release Please (see PR #311 — merged, but no release/package followed). Force 'fix', analogous to the matrix-synapse rule above.
Ketesa version bumps default to 'chore', which does not trigger a Release Please release or image rebuild. Force 'fix', like the matrix_auth_service rule above.

Automerge only for low-risk updates: minor/patch of npm/pip dependencies and GitHub Actions, only after a 48-hour (2-day) waiting period and only with green checks (smoke test, AppArmor, lint). Majors stay manual (see appbuildrules 7, test them together). platformAutomerge is deliberately off: GitHub's auto-merge only waits for the required checks of the ruleset, and the path-filtered build test is not one of them. Renovate therefore merges itself, and only once all checks of the PR are green.
Apps with a database/migrations are NEVER merged automatically (no downgrade possible). Must come after the automerge rule so it wins.

The frontend of unifi_os_control_center is not built in CI: the image copies the checked-in frontend/dist. No check verifies npm updates there, so no automerge as long as dist is built by hand. Must come after the automerge rule so it wins.

customManagers.description: Track NLnetLabs/unbound upstream releases for ARG UNBOUND_VERSION in unbound/Dockerfile. The tag format on GitHub is 'release-X.Y.Z', hence extractVersionTemplate. Only bumps the plain upstream version; the manual '-haNN-pol4rN' suffix in config.yaml is left untouched (see the Release Please exception).

Track etkecc/ketesa (formerly Synapse Admin) releases. The script fetches the version live via the GitHub API at runtime; this fallback value is only used if the API call fails — Renovate still keeps it current as a reference/dashboard visibility.

Track matrix-synapse PyPI releases for the minimum version in matrix_synapse/Dockerfile. A pip install without a Renovate PR automatically gets the latest version >= this lower bound on the next image build, but without a trigger no rebuild happens at all. This manager creates PRs for new Synapse releases and thereby kicks off the rebuild.

Track mautrix/whatsapp upstream releases for ARG in matrix_whatsapp_bridge/Dockerfile. The tag format on GitHub is 'vX.YYMM.0'. Pulls the version WITHOUT the 'v' prefix so it matches the companion manager for matrix_whatsapp_bridge/config.yaml 1:1 (both bump in the same PR, since they use the same datasourceTemplate/packageNameTemplate). The manual '-haNN-pol4rN' suffix in config.yaml stays manual work (Release Please exception); only the upstream version is kept in sync.

Track mautrix/signal upstream releases for ARG in matrix_signal_bridge/Dockerfile. The tag format on GitHub is 'vX.YYMM.0'. Pulls the version WITHOUT the 'v' prefix so it matches the companion manager for matrix_signal_bridge/config.yaml 1:1 (both bump in the same PR, since they use the same datasourceTemplate/packageNameTemplate). The manual '-haNN-pol4rN' suffix in config.yaml stays manual work (Release Please exception); only the upstream version is kept in sync.

Pulls the version WITHOUT the 'v' prefix so it matches the companion manager for matrix_telegram_bridge/config.yaml 1:1 (both bump in the same PR, since they use the same datasourceTemplate/packageNameTemplate). Track element-hq/matrix-authentication-service GHCR releases for ARG MAS_VERSION in matrix_auth_service/Dockerfile. GitHub tags have a 'v' prefix (e.g. v1.22.0), Docker tags do not (1.22.0) - extractVersionTemplate aligns them, analogous to the unbound manager.
Track etkecc/ketesa releases for ARG KETESA_VERSION in matrix_ketesa/Dockerfile. The value keeps the 'v' prefix of the GitHub tag, because the download URL uses the tag.

Companion to ARG WHATSAPP_VERSION: keeps the upstream version in matrix_whatsapp_bridge/config.yaml in sync with the Dockerfile ARG. extractVersionTemplate strips the 'v' prefix; the '-ha1-pol4r1' suffix is left untouched (only the number before it is replaced).
